definitions.explanation: The systematic pursuit of knowledge; academic discipline.

examples.japanese: {学問|がくもん}に{王道|おうどう}なし。
examples.english: There is no royal road to learning.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{学問|がくもん}のある{人|ひと}だ。

notes:
{学問|がくもん} refers to academic learning and scholarship.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {学問|がくもん}する (to study - formal)
- {学問|がくもん}に{励|はげ}む (to devote oneself to study)
- {学問|がくもん}を{修|おさ}める (to acquire learning)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {学問|がくもん}{的|てき} (academic, scholarly)
- {学問|がくもん}の{自由|じゆう} (academic freedom)

PROVERBS:
- {学問|がくもん}に{王道|おうどう}なし (No royal road to learning)
- {学問|がくもん}のすすめ (Encouragement of Learning - famous book by Fukuzawa Yukichi)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勉強|べんきょう}: study (more casual)
- {学習|がくしゅう}: study, learning
- {学問|がくもん}: scholarship (more formal, academic)
